messages:
rachel: Quick note — onboarding AetherX-8B (LLama-ish variant with fractional-rotary and hybrid head dims) into our int4 flow. Hit a reproducible regression on ZWJ/emoji sequences. Minimal repro and logs below. Anyone seen this combo before? :eyes:

rachel: repro:
```bash
python export.py --model aetherx-8b --out aetherx_fp16.onnx --dtype fp16
python quantize_awq.py --in aetherx_fp16.onnx --out aetherx_int4.onnx --opt axis_swap
python sample_small.py --model aetherx_int4.onnx --prompt "They said \u200d\u2764\ufe0f loudly" --log-tokens
```

rachel: logs (sanitized):
```
# fp16 tokens: [9, 312, 19876, 7]
# int4 tokens: [9, 312, 9421, 7]
# embed cos_sim[0]: 0.999 -> 0.82
```

liam: axis_swap/permute again. Does AetherX have non-uniform head dims or freq_scale != 1? global reshape will break offsets.

rachel: yes, hybrid heads (64/48 mix) and rotary freq_scale=0.85 in checkpoint metadata. Export currently computes freq on-the-fly (no explicit initializer).

priya: tokenizer angle: ZWJ joins are sensitive to normalizer differences (NFKC vs NFC) and our quant path uses a micro-tokenizer shim. If axis_swap runs before or near embedding/proj it can change byte offsets and flip token boundaries for multi-codepoint glyphs.

devops-bot: [ci] aetherx_int4_onboard_smoke failed  tokenization/regression. https://ci.internal/job/6011

liam: quick isolation: quantize with --no-axis-swap -> token ids match FP16 for this prompt, but logits still show small drift (~0.6% next-prob RMS). So two things: (1) axis_swap causes token split, (2) quant rounding + implicit rotary recompute causes phase drift.

priya: plan: 1) quantizer: when head_dims non-uniform or metadata.rotary_fractional -> emit per-head reshape+transpose instead of global axis_swap; 2) exporter: materialize rotary_freq as an initializer if freq_scale != 1.0; 3) tokenizer: add opt-in pre-normalize hook (collapse common ZWJ sequences) for onboarding; 4) CI: add small 20-prompt ZWJ/emoji bench.

rachel: I ran a quick prototype with per-head transforms + explicit freq initializers. Early bench (30 prompts) shows token parity 98.6% and BLEU delta ~0.5. Without the changes parity drops <90 and BLEU delta >3.

liam: also add KV-cache index smoke tests after per-head transform — offsets shift and we've tripped on that before.

priya: I'll open PR `onboard/aetherx-rotary-hybridhead-fix` with repro, CI link, and checklist. Tag onboard/aetherx and quant/rotary-fix.

rachel: added tokenizer unit test request for multi-codepoint ZWJ sequences to ticket #5033.

devops-bot: created issue #5033 for tokenizer test coverage.

liam: thanks — once PR is up I'll kick off a small Dedicated canary. summary: root cause = global axis_swap + hetero head_dims + implicit rotary recompute + tokenizer microshim; fixes = per-head permute, rotary initializer, opt-in tokenizer canonicalize, CI emoji bench. :thumbsup:
